name: website
label: Company website
help: Without it, the domain of the email address is used.

nested.name: body
nested.label: Email body
nested.help: Your email. FirstLine writes only the [[slot · instruction · max words]] parts, e.g. [[opener · something specific from their website · 25]].

nested.name: campaign_id
nested.label: Campaign ID
nested.help: From the campaign's address in FirstLine.

name: wait
label: Wait for the result (seconds)
help: If it takes longer, use Get a job with the returned Job ID.

name: idempotency_key
label: Idempotency key
help: Something unique per lead, e.g. the row number. A retried run then returns the same result and is never charged twice.
